summary: Sarah Westhoff, 29, slipped while descending Mount Yale and tumbled ~500 ft down a snowfield into rocks, suffering multiple facial fractures and severe frostbite on her feet; companion Kendall Westhoff called Chaffee County SAR via Garmin inReach; overnight foot rescue moved her to treeline and a helicopter evacuated her at daybreak to Aurora
responding_agency: Chaffee County Search and Rescue; helicopter evac; UCHealth Burn and Frostbite Center
